10800.name: The Tombs of Atuan

up.description: To the up lies Entrance to the Undertombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10800.description:
Cold air breathes against your face in a low vault of black stone, and
your footsteps come back to you a heartbeat late. Rows of burial niches
line the walls, each sealed with a slab carved with the same watching
eye. Dust lies undisturbed on the floor, except for one long groove
where something once dragged itself. The silence here is attentive, as
though the dead were listening.

10801.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10801.description:
A tall vault of fitted stone block rises into shadow here, its pillars
carved with hooded figures who press both hands over their eyes. A
single lamp-niche still holds a crust of black tallow. The walls sweat a
slow, cold damp that gathers in dark beads and runs down in thin lines.
Somewhere deeper in the tombs, water drips with the patience of
centuries.

10802.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10802.description:
Broken sarcophagi sprawl across the floor of this chamber, their lids
cracked and slid aside to show empty hollows lined with rotted velvet.
Scraps of bronze and bone crunch underfoot. Faded sigils crawl across
the ceiling in spirals, and the air tastes of cold ash. You feel unseen
eyes settle on the back of your neck.

10803.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10803.description:
Spider silk drapes this crypt in grey curtains, thick as cloth and
sagging under the weight of dust. Between the strands you glimpse a long
stone table scored with channels, and shallow bowls stained dark. The
floor is gritty with the husks of dead insects. Every sound you make is
swallowed by the webs.

10804.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10804.description:
A pool of black water fills the middle of the vault, perfectly still and
perfectly clear, reflecting the roof so exactly that it seems a second
chamber lies beneath. Narrow ledges of wet stone run around its edge,
worn by the feet of long-dead mourners. A chill rises from the surface
and clings to your skin. Smudged handprints mark the walls at shoulder
height.

10805.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10805.description:
Pillars like fat stone trunks crowd this hall, each carved with the name
of a long-dead priestess in letters older than any tongue of the realm.
The floor is a mosaic of black and bone-white tiles, many cracked, laid
in the spiral of a great eye. A thin draught carries a whisper that
might be words or only wind in the stone.

10806.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10806.description:
Part of the roof has fallen here, and a heap of tumbled slabs and earth
fills one end of the vault, spilling bones across the floor. Shards of
painted pottery lie among them, still bright with ochre and indigo. Dust
hangs in the air, motionless. The walls lean, and you step softly,
afraid to wake the stone.

10807.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10807.description:
A low gallery of niches runs around this chamber, each holding a skull
on a little shelf, jaws gaping. Dried flowers, brown and brittle as
paper, lie at their bases as if placed by hand a thousand years ago. A
brazier of rusted iron stands cold in the middle of the floor. The air
is still and tastes of old incense.

10808.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

south.description: To the south lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10808.description:
Four stone statues of hooded women ring this crypt, their faces worn
smooth, their arms outstretched toward the centre with the palms turned
up. A shallow bowl of stone between them is crusted with something
black. The chill is deeper here than elsewhere in the tombs, and your
breath turns to pale smoke that hangs before you.

10809.name: The Tombs of Atuan

north.description: To the north lies The Tombs of Atuan.

west.description: To the west lies The Painted Room.

10809.description:
Heavy iron bands bind a great stone door set in the far wall of this
vault, its surface carved with rows of weeping masks. Soot stains the
roof where lamps once burned. Splintered coffin wood is stacked against
the walls like firewood for a funeral. The stone seems to hum faintly
under your feet.

10810.name: The Painted Room

west.description: To the west lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

east.description: To the east lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10810.description:
Every inch of wall and ceiling in this square chamber is painted:
processions of pale figures with black eyes, serpents swallowing stars,
a veiled woman in a high crown seated among the dead. The colours are
astonishingly fresh, as if the artist had only just stepped away. A
heavy door in the west wall leads out to the Curving Road to Distrust.

extra_descs.painted figures procession paintings wal:
The pale figures walk in single file toward the woman in the crown, each
holding something out to her: a key, a mirror, a severed braid. Every
black eye in the procession seems to be turned toward whoever stands in
the doorway.

10811.name: Entrance to the Undertombs

up.description: To the up lies At The Centre Of The Ruins.

down.description: To the down lies The Tombs of Atuan.

10811.description:
A broad stair of black stone comes down from the ruined city and ends in
a small, square vestibule whose walls are carved with ranks of closed
eyes. Cold, still air flows from the dark below, and daylight from the
ruins reaches only this far. Steps climb up to the centre of the ruins,
and a low archway opens down into the Tombs of Atuan.

10812.name: The Panopticum of Petrified Souls
10812.description:
Hundreds of figures of grey stone stand in tiers around this circular
hall, each frozen in a gesture of terror, mouths open and hands raised.
Their faces are those of living people, down to the lines about the
eyes. The whole assembly is turned inward toward the empty centre, as if
waiting. A thin, chorus-like moaning seems to come from the stone
itself.

extra_descs.figures statues souls:
Up close the stone has a faint warmth. Each figure wears the clothes of
its own age: a farmer's smock, a soldier's mail, a child's shift. Not
one of them has been carved, only caught.

10813.name: The Curving Road to Distrust

north.description: To the north lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

east.description: To the east lies The Painted Room.

10813.description:
The road of the tombs begins its slow curve here, a wide paved way
between walls that lean inward overhead. Narrow slits are cut into the
stone at the height of a man's eyes, empty and dark, so that you feel
watched from within the walls. Each flagstone is engraved with a crude
padlock. The road bends away north into dimness.

10814.name: The Curving Road to Distrust

east.description: To the east lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

south.description: To the south lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

10814.description:
The road bends hard here, hugging a wall of grey stone. Little niches in
the wall hold clay masks, each one turned to face the road with a sly,
sidelong smile. The floor is gritty with cold ash. The way runs east
along the bend, and south back to the road's beginning.

10815.name: The Curving Road to Distrust

north.description: To the north lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

west.description: To the west lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

10815.description:
The curve tightens and the roof comes down low, forcing you to stoop.
Words are scratched into the wall in a hundred different hands, all of
them variations of the same warning: trust none who walk behind you.
Echoes follow a step too quickly. The road runs on north along the
curve, and west back toward the bend.

10816.name: The Curving Road to Distrust

north.description: To the north lies The Dead End of Distrust.

south.description: To the south lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

10816.description:
Here the road straightens into a long colonnade of squat, round pillars,
each bearing a stone eye set in its face. Lamps hang unlit from chains
between them. The darkness ahead looks too deep and still to be the
ordinary dark. The way runs north toward the end of the road and south
back to the curve.

10817.name: The Dead End of Distrust

south.description: To the south lies The Curving Road to Distrust.

10817.description:
The road ends against a blank wall of seamless black stone, polished
until it throws your own face back at you. A doorway has been filled in
with masonry, its carved frame still trailing cobwebs, as if the
builders changed their minds. A heap of old bones lies in one corner.
The only way out is south, back along the road.

10820.name: The Ridge of Death
10820.description:
The ridge is a spine of dark rock, narrow as a plank, running through an
echoing cavern whose roof you cannot see. On either hand the dark falls
away into a hush that swallows pebbles without a sound. The stone is
rubbed smooth by centuries of cautious feet. A cold breeze tugs at your
clothes.

10821.name: The Ridge of Death
10821.description:
Old bones lie scattered along the ridge, some wedged into cracks and
some half over the edge, picked clean and bleached. The rock is slick
with a skin of damp. Far below, something glows faintly, a dull red that
never flickers. You keep your eyes on your feet.

10822.name: The Ridge of Death
10822.description:
The ridge bends around a pillar of stone, forcing you to inch round its
girth with your back to the open cavern. Tally marks and prayers are
scratched into the pillar, hundreds of them, in many hands. A dull echo
answers each step. The darkness around feels vast and attentive.

10823.name: The Ridge of Death
10823.description:
Part of the ridge has sheared away, leaving a gap you must stride across
with the dark yawning beneath. Loose grit rattles from your boots and
falls for a long time. A rusted chain is anchored in the rock, its far
end vanishing into the gloom. The wind moans in the hollows of the
cavern.

10824.name: The Ridge of Death
10824.description:
Here the ridge broadens to a stone shelf strewn with offerings: cracked
bowls, tarnished coins, small clay figures with their faces rubbed away.
Each lies where it was placed, untouched by dust. A low, regular sound
like breathing rises from the depths. The feeling of being watched is
strongest on this shelf.

10825.name: The Ridge of Death
10825.description:
Veins of pale crystal glitter in the rock, giving the dark just enough
glimmer to show the sheer fall on both sides. Your footfalls jump from
wall to wall and return changed, as if answered. A cluster of black
stalactites hangs low overhead. The ridge tilts slightly under you.

10826.name: The Ridge of Death
10826.description:
The ridge ends in a wide, flat platform of worn rock, ringed by crude
pillars topped with spear-shaped stones. Scorch marks and old wax blotch
the floor where rites were once held. A great silence lies on the place,
thick as felt. In the hush you can hear your own pulse.

10827.name: The Landing opposite the Chasm

up.description: To the up lies Ascension to Pride.

10827.description:
The landing is a ledge of cut stone facing the lip of a vast chasm,
whose far side is lost in darkness. A rail of iron has half rotted from
the edge and hangs by a single bolt. Echoes ring back from the opposite
wall, strangely delayed. A stair of worn steps climbs up from the
landing to the Ascension to Pride.

10828.name: Ascension to Pride

up.description: To the up lies Ascension to Pride.

down.description: To the down lies The Landing opposite the Chasm.

10828.description:
The stair climbs steeply between walls carved in tall relief: crowned
figures treading on bowed backs, one rank above the next. Each step is
worn into a shallow dish by long use. Torch brackets hold nothing but
char. The stair rises to a higher landing, and falls back to the ledge
above the chasm.

10829.name: Ascension to Pride

north.description: To the north lies Before the Throne of Acrasia.

down.description: To the down lies Ascension to Pride.

10829.description:
At the head of the climb the stair levels into a short hall of polished
black marble, its walls lined with tall mirrors dulled by age. Your
reflection, pale and wavering, seems to arrive a moment late. A cold
light spills from the north end of the hall, where wide doors stand open
on the throne room. The stair falls away down behind you.

10831.name: Before the Throne of Acrasia

south.description: To the south lies Ascension to Pride.

10831.description:
A high round hall opens here, domed in black stone and ringed with tall
pillars carved with the figure of a crowned and veiled woman. At its
centre a throne of dark glass stands on a dais of seven steps, so
polished that the room seems to hang inside it. The air is thick with
old incense and stranger things. The only way out is south, through the
hall of the Ascension to Pride.

extra_descs.throne glass dais:
The throne is a single block of black glass, its arms carved as clasped
hands. Looking into it, you see the hall behind you, with a seated shape
that is not in the room.

10832.name: Descent to Despair

west.description: To the west lies the Altar of Pride.

down.description: To the down lies Descent to Despair.

south.description: To the south lies the Altar of Pride.

10832.description:
A steep stair spirals downward here into colder stone, its walls sooted
and bare. An archway to the west opens on a small chamber where an altar
can be glimpsed. The steps are cut shorter than a stride, so that every
footfall must be careful. Somewhere below, a slow dripping marks the
time, and the stair continues down.

10833.name: Descent to Despair

south.description: To the south lies Descent to Despair.

up.description: To the up lies Descent to Despair.

10833.description:
The descent narrows to a gullet of stone where your shoulders almost
brush both walls. Faint scratches, as of fingernails, mark the rock at
head height. A damp wind breathes up from below and smells of the grave.
The stair runs on south into the dark, and climbs back up toward the
altar chamber.

10834.name: The Snare of Despair

west.description: To the west lies Descent to Despair.

10834.description:
The floor of this round room is a lattice of iron bars laid over a pit
of darkness. Rusted jaws and wire loops hang from the ceiling on slack
chains, waiting. Bleached bones lie where the unwary stopped. The only
way out is west, back to the foot of the stair.

10835.name: the Altar of Pride

north.description: To the north lies Descent to Despair.

10835.description:
A small round chamber holds a single altar of white marble, stained dark
in a ring around its rim. Over it hangs a hammered gold sun, long
tarnished, gazing blindly at the floor. Offering plates lie scattered,
their gifts rotted to dust. The way out is north, back to the stair.

extra_descs.altar marble sun:
The altar's rim is worn into a groove by a thousand years of hands. A
line of letters on its face reads that pride is the last sacrifice, and
the first.

10836.name: Descent to Despair

north.description: To the north lies Descent to Despair.

down.description: To the down lies Descent to Despair.

10836.description:
The stair turns sharply here beside a pit of blackness where a landing
should be. Chains hang from the roof, ending in empty iron collars that
sway when you pass. Every step is slick with condensation. The way back
lies north, while the stair drops on down.

10837.name: Descent to Despair

east.description: To the east lies The Snare of Despair.

up.description: To the up lies Descent to Despair.

10837.description:
At the bottom of the stair the walls close around a low vault of
dripping rock. A heavy smell of rust and wet stone hangs in the air. A
passage opens east into a chamber ringed with iron rings, and behind you
the stair rises up the way you came.

10850.name: The Treasure Room

east.description: To the east lies At the Mound among the Ruins.

10850.description:
Heaps of tarnished treasure lie in this vault: chests burst open, gold
gone green, jewelled cups, tapestries rotted to threads. Tall pillars
carved with coiling serpents hold up a ceiling blackened by old smoke. A
passage opens in the east wall, and from it comes the faint, salt-
smelling light of the ruins by the sea, where it climbs toward the Mound
among the Ruins.

646100.name: spider crypt pale
646100.long_desc: A pale crypt spider clings to the stone, its bloated body twitching.
646100.description:
A spider as large as a dog, its body white as a grub and its legs banded
in grey. It has lived on the dead so long that it knows nothing else.

646101.name: skeleton tomb bones warrior
646101.long_desc: A tomb skeleton shambles forward, bits of burial bronze clinking on its ribs.
646101.description:
Yellowed bones wired together by old magic, still wearing the scraps of
a burial mask and chain. Its jaw clacks silently as it comes.

646102.name: acolyte cultist nameless robed
646102.short_desc: a hooded acolyte of the Nameless
646102.long_desc: A hooded cultist of the Nameless stands very still, hands tucked into long sleeves.
646102.description:
A pale cultist in a black robe, eyes hidden by a deep hood. The robe is
stitched with a single open eye in red thread.

646103.name: gargoyle stone weeping
646103.long_desc: A weeping stone gargoyle crouches among the pale figures, its grey cheeks streaked with damp.
646103.description:
A hunched monster of grey stone with folded wings and a human face,
always weeping a thin trickle of water. It moves only when no one is
looking, or so it seems.

646104.name: guardian stone guard golem
646104.long_desc: A stone guardian stands against the wall, one great hand resting on a spiked mace.
646104.description:
A towering guard hewn from black stone, with a blank face and hollow
eyes that follow you. It was set here to keep the way and never learned
that the war was over.

646105.name: priest cultist nameless grey
646105.short_desc: a grey priest of the Nameless
646105.long_desc: A grey priest of the Nameless chants low beside the dark, ash smeared on his brow.
646105.description:
A gaunt cultist with ash-grey skin and a shaved skull marked by three
blue lines. He tends the old rites with grim patience, and his eyes are
quite empty of mercy.

646106.name: kossil priestess cultist high
646106.short_desc: Kossil, high priestess of the Nameless
646106.long_desc: Kossil, high priestess of the Nameless, kneels at the altar with a knife in her hand.
646106.description:
A thin, severe woman in a black robe stiff with silver thread, her face
as hard as the altar before her. A curved knife of black glass never
leaves her hand.

646107.name: acrasia ghost queen veiled
646107.short_desc: Acrasia, the ghost queen of the tombs
646107.long_desc: Acrasia, the ghost queen of the tombs, sits veiled upon her throne and watches you come.
646107.description:
The ancient queen of the tombs, a tall figure veiled in shadow whose
glass-clear form lets the throne show through. Her voice is a cold, soft
whisper that seems to speak from inside your own head.

746100.name: burial mask gilded gold
746100.room_desc: A gilded burial mask stares up from the floor here.
746100.description: A thin sheet of gold beaten into a calm human face, with closed eyes and a faint, secret smile. It was made to cover the dead.

746101.name: robe black hooded acolyte
746101.room_desc: A black hooded robe lies crumpled here.
746101.description: A heavy black robe, its hem stiff with grave-dust and an open red eye stitched across the breast.

746102.name: gauntlets stone guardian hands
746102.room_desc: A pair of stone gauntlets lies here, heavy as anvils.
746102.description: Gauntlets carved from dark, fine-grained stone and fitted with iron hinges. They are astonishingly heavy, and astonishingly sure.

746103.name: knife obsidian black glass curved
746103.room_desc: A curved obsidian knife lies here, edge gleaming.
746103.description: A sacrificial knife with a blade of black volcanic glass, so sharp that the edge cannot be seen from the side. The bone grip is bound in red thread.

746104.name: diadem acrasia black silver crown
746104.room_desc: A black diadem rests here, cold as a well.
746104.description: A slender band of black metal woven with silver threads and set with one clouded white stone, like a blind eye. It is cold to the touch, and when worn it seems to hear.
